How to measure your roof in one step

blocks.text: Nine lengths. Which one is yours?
The roof cover comes in nine lengths, 18 to 44 ft (5.5 to 13.5 m), all 10 ft (3 m) wide. Measure your roof front to back, then pick the next length up.

blocks.altText: Roof Cover for Travel Trailers & Motorhomes 18–44 ft

blocks.text: Roof Cover for Travel Trailers & Motorhomes 18–44 ft
